name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2022-12-01.395.2) introduced by ACT Senator [Katy Gallagher](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/katy_gallagher) (Labor), which means it passed. ### Motion text > *That—* > > *(a) after consideration of the [Animal Health Australia and Plant Health Australia Funding Legislation Amendment Bill 2022](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6913) has concluded, the questions on all remaining stages of the [Financial Sector Reform Bill 2022](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6909) only be put without debate; and* > > *(b) paragraph (a) operate as a limitation of debate under [standing order 142](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Chamber_documents/Senate_chamber_documents/standingorders/b00/b20#standing-order_c20-142).*
